name: World Peace Pagoda above Phewa Lake
why: A short climb through forest from the dam of Phewa Lake to a white stupa on the hill, with the lake, Pokhara and the Annapurna range below.
book: Free. Many cross the lake by rowing boat to the Anadu landing and walk down here instead.

points.name: Damside
points.note: The dam at the south end of Phewa Lake, called Damside.

points.name: World Peace Pagoda
points.note: A white Buddhist stupa built by Japanese monks on Anadu hill.
